genomes.name: A4 Red Day Near Mean, Above 50
genomes.thesis: Red day near the 20-day mean, also above the 50-day.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.05 and close > sma20 * 0.97 and close > sma50 and volume_ratio > 1.2

genomes.name: B7 Capitulation With Trend
genomes.thesis: Capitulation candle only when the fund is above its 200-day mean.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.04 and (close - low) / (high - low + 0.0001) < 0.25 and volume_ratio > 1.3 and close > sma200

genomes.name: B8 Capitulation Above 50
genomes.thesis: Capitulation candle only above the 50-day mean.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.04 and (close - low) / (high - low + 0.0001) < 0.25 and volume_ratio > 1.3 and close > sma50

genomes.name: B9 Capitulation, 5 Positions
genomes.thesis: Capitulation candle, five 20% positions instead of four 25% ones.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.04 and (close - low) / (high - low + 0.0001) < 0.25 and volume_ratio > 1.3

genomes.name: C5 Red Day Above 200
genomes.thesis: 5% down day with the fund above its 200-day mean.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.05 and close > sma200 and volume_ratio > 1.0

genomes.name: C6 Red Day -6% Above 50
genomes.thesis: 6% down day above the 50-day mean.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.06 and close > sma50 and volume_ratio > 1.0

genomes.name: C7 Red Day Above 50, Bottom Half
genomes.thesis: Above the 50-day, closing in the lower half of the range.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.05 and close > sma50 and volume_ratio > 1.0 and (close - low) / (high - low + 0.0001) < 0.5

genomes.name: D4 RSI7 < 40 Above 50, 2-Bar
genomes.thesis: Oversold in an uptrend with a strict two-bar clock.

entry_rules.when: rsi7 < 40 and close > sma50

genomes.name: D5 RSI7 < 40 Above 200
genomes.thesis: Oversold, gated on the 200-day mean.

entry_rules.when: rsi7 < 40 and close > sma200

genomes.name: D6 RSI7 < 40 Above 50, Fast Exit
genomes.thesis: Oversold in an uptrend; +3% or two bars.

entry_rules.when: rsi7 < 40 and close > sma50

genomes.name: D7 RSI7 < 40 Above 50, Red Close
genomes.thesis: Oversold in an uptrend, entered only on a down close.

entry_rules.when: rsi7 < 40 and close > sma50 and ret1 < 0

genomes.name: H2 Pullback Cluster Above 200
genomes.thesis: Two red closes and a 3% weekly loss above the 200-day.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < 0 and prev(ret1) < 0 and ret5 < -0.03 and close > sma200 and volume_ratio > 1.1

genomes.name: H3 Pullback Cluster, No Volume
genomes.thesis: Two red closes and a 3% weekly loss above the 50-day, no volume gate.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < 0 and prev(ret1) < 0 and ret5 < -0.03 and close > sma50

genomes.name: H4 Pullback Cluster, Deeper
genomes.thesis: Two red closes and a 5% weekly loss above the 50-day.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < 0 and prev(ret1) < 0 and ret5 < -0.05 and close > sma50

genomes.name: I1 Close Below Prior Low
genomes.thesis: A close under yesterday's low while above the 50-day; +3% or two bars.

entry_rules.when: close < prev(low) and close > sma50

genomes.name: I2 Close Below Prior Low, Volume
genomes.thesis: Same, on 1.2x volume.

entry_rules.when: close < prev(low) and close > sma50 and volume_ratio > 1.2

genomes.name: J1 Gap-Down Reversal
genomes.thesis: Opened 3% below the prior close and closed above the open, near the 50-day.

entry_rules.when: open < prev(close) * 0.97 and close > open and close > sma50 * 0.95

genomes.name: J2 Gap-Down, Any Close
genomes.thesis: Opened 3% below the prior close, near the 50-day, whatever the close.

entry_rules.when: open < prev(close) * 0.97 and close > sma50 * 0.95

genomes.name: L1 Volume Climax
genomes.thesis: Twice normal volume on a 3% down day; +3% or two bars.

entry_rules.when: volume_ratio > 2.0 and ret1 < -0.03

genomes.name: L2 Volume Climax Above 50
genomes.thesis: Twice normal volume on a 3% down day, above the 50-day.

entry_rules.when: volume_ratio > 2.0 and ret1 < -0.03 and close > sma50

genomes.name: N1 Red Day, Reclaim Exit
genomes.thesis: 3% down day above the 50-day; out when the 10-day mean is reclaimed or three bars.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.03 and close > sma50
